claim_definition: The verifier MUST detect when a valid script is mutated (a single value changed) and reject the mutated input. This proves the verifier is not just checking structure but is actually evaluating the computation.

test_cases.description: Mutation test: takes the valid TC-001 script but changes the payload from 1000 to 99999 (an extreme outlier). The verifier MUST detect that the mutated payload produces a different residual and report failure.
